what: Neon-noir groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1: four tracks, seven sources, tape and megacity space FX, sixteen scales (Insen, Hirajoshi, Iwato, whole tone), and forty-four Blade Runner factory sounds. Its screen: a glitched landscape that tears with the sound.
author: saulofilho
sounds: CC0: the four factory samples (assets/samples) are from the GR!MM firmware by GRiMMBIENT, released under CC0 1.0; the recordings on the hub page (hub/audio) are my own, recorded from this firmware
